description: CR 609.4b / 701.10f: under Celestial Dawn, Doubling Cube's copies of white mana spend as any color but not as colorless, so a spell needing {C} is not offered
note: The Plains pay the Cube's {3} and it doubles three white into six, which pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} but not {C}. A copy counted as whatever the white may be spent as would include red, which Celestial Dawn spends only as colorless, and offer Slivdrazi Monstrosity.
